row: Red River Animal Emergency Hospital and Referral Center of North Dakota has been dedicated to delivering the highest quality and compassionate care to the veterinary communities of North Dakota, South Dakota, and Minnesota for almost two decades. Located in Fargo, we are North Dakota’s only 24/7 emergency hospital who also offers multiple specialty services. At RRAEH, we are committed to the overall care and well-being of our patients and their families, our referring veterinarians, and our employees! At RRAEH, We Care!
